bibl.title: Three Edicts of Caracalla? A New Reading of P.Giss. 40.
bibl.seg: 145.4 P. Giss. I, 40 P. Oxy. XXXVI, 2755
Peter van Minnen, Three Edicts of Caracalla? A New Reading of P.Giss. 40.
bibl.note: The number of texts on the papyrus: the Constitutio Antoniniana and one more [dates the CA to July 11, 212; a further copy of the end of the CA is to be found in P. Oxy. XXXVI, 2755]. - The publication note in P. Giss. I, 40, col. 2, ll. 12-15. - Some remarks on the disputed text of P. Giss. I, 40, col. 1, ll. 7-9. - Conclusions.
